terms.name: asset
terms.definition: the declared net asset value of the applicant

terms.name: overdue
terms.definition: an unpaid obligation past its due date for more than the window

conventions.time_window: six calendar months before the application timestamp, both ends inclusive
evidence_sources: the declared asset valuation report submitted with the application
the payment-history ledger of record for the overdue window

levels.name: deny
levels.definition: credit denied under the override rule

rules.coverage: any overdue longer than three months in the window denies credit regardless of assets
assets above 30 (USD-millions) with no overdue in the window grant the 50,000 line
exceptions: assets exactly at the 30 cutoff are an open boundary — the outcome is on_undefined_rule until the owner settles the cutoff convention

rules.coverage: assets below 1 (USD-millions) grant the 10,000 line; the six-month condition attaches to the upper band only

resolution.on_missing_evidence: request admissible asset valuation; record a semantic issue for the owner — not an automatic denial
resolution.on_undefined_rule: apply no rule; record a semantic issue for the authorized business owner

examples.expected: the cutoff is an open specification question — the upper rule's exception names it, so the outcome is on_undefined_rule until the owner settles it
deny — the override rule's precedence 0 beats both band rules

examples.case: assets 0.5 with a clean window versus assets 0.9 with a clean window
examples.expected: both take the lower band — the rule scopes by band, not by exact value
on_missing_evidence — request evidence, record the issue, no automatic negative business answer

examples.case: assets between 1 and 30 (exclusive of neither cutoff), no overdue
examples.expected: uncovered by any band rule — on_undefined_rule records a semantic issue for the owner; no default grant
the 1 cutoff is open the same way as 30 — on_undefined_rule, not a silent lower-band grant

scope.supported: the illustrative three-rule credit eligibility question for natural-person applicants in the owner's pilot region

ownership.effective_scope: pilot region, v1.0.0, effective from publication
